description.title: תנאי פוליסה – הודעה ואישור
description.summary: This table outlines the insured's duties regarding notification of events, cooperation with investigations, and restrictions on admissions related to claims under the policy. It details requirements for informing the insurer about investigations, proceedings, and providing relevant documentation.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את חובות המבוטח בנוגע להודעה על אירועים, שיתוף פעולה עם חקירות והגבלות על הודאות הקשורות לתביעות במסגרת הפוליסה. מכלול דורשת מהמבוטח להודיע לה מיד עם ידיעתו על אירוע ביטוחי, וכן על כל הליך משפטי או חקירה הקשורה לאירוע. המבוטח חייב גם להעביר למכלול כל מסמך רלוונטי שקיבל, כגון זימונים או הודעות שימוע. אי עמידה בתנאים אלו עלולה להשפיע על זכאות המבוטח לתגמולים. הפוליסה מתייחסת להודעה על אירוע ביטוחי, חקירה של נסיבות המוות, או כתב אישום הקשורים לאירוע ביטוחי. מכלול עשויה לבקר במקומות השייכים למבוטח לצורך חקירה או בדיקה.
notable_values: Condition: 9.8 - Notice of an insured event

sketch:
9.9 Prohibition of admission
No admission, proposal, promise, undertaking or compensation of any type shall be made or given by the insured or on its behalf, without the prior written consent of the insurer, in connection with any insured event which is covered under this policy. The provisions of this condition shall not apply to reporting of facts regarding the insured event to the police or any lawfully authorized entity, upon their request, as well as to giving testimony in Court.
9.10 Notice regarding proceedings
The insured shall notify the insurer as soon as possible of a police or other investigation, an investigation of the causes of death or any indictment which are open or about to be opened -if same are known to it in connection with any insured event which is covered under this policy.
9.11 Provision of documents by the insured to the insurer
The insured will submit to the insurer, immediately upon receipt thereof, any information, letter, summons, notice of a hearing, order and any process in connection with/due to any insured event which is covered by this policy.

טבלה: תנאי פוליסה – הודעה ואישור
This table outlines the insured's duties regarding notification of events, cooperation with investigations, and restrictions on admissions related to claims under the policy. It details requirements for informing the insurer about investigations, proceedings, and providing relevant documentation.
ממדים: Policy Condition, Requirement/Restriction

9.9 Prohibition of admission
No admission, proposal, promise, undertaking or compensation of any type shall be made or given by the insured or on its behalf, without the prior written consent of the insurer, in connection with any insured event which is covered under this policy. The provisions of this condition shall not apply to reporting of facts regarding the insured event to the police or any lawfully authorized entity, upon their request, as well as to giving testimony in Court.
9.10 Notice regarding proceedings
The insured shall notify the insurer as soon as possible of a police or other investigation, an investigation of the causes of death or any indictment which are open or about to be opened -if same are known to it in connection with any insured event which is covered under this policy.
9.11 Provision of documents by the insured to the insurer
The insured will submit to the insurer, immediately upon receipt thereof, any information, letter, summons, notice of a hearing, order and any process in connection with/due to any insured event which is covered by this policy.
